CCA

Climate Change Agreements

Climate Change Agreements are voluntary deals for energy-intensive businesses: hit an energy-efficiency target and you pay much less Climate Change Levy on your energy bills. A new scheme started in 2026, with targets set for each facility rather than for groups.

Draft guide. We're checking this page against official sources before launch. Always confirm with your regulator.

Step 1

Are you in scope?

You're probably in if…

  • Your facility carries out an eligible energy-intensive process (listed by sector, from food and drink to chemicals and metals)
  • You joined the new scheme. Existing participants had to reapply, with an application window in 2025

You're probably out if…

  • Sites not in an eligible sector
  • Old-scheme participants who did not reapply for the new scheme

Who regulates it: Environment Agency as scheme administrator. Your sector association holds the umbrella agreement for your sector.

Step 2

Your yearly routine

  1. Target periodsTP7: 2026 (the first of the new scheme) · TP8: 2027–2028 · TP9: 2029–2030
  2. 1 May after each periodSubmit your target period data: 1 May 2027 for 2026, then 1 May 2029 and 1 May 2031
  3. After assessmentPay a buy-out fee for any shortfall against target, or lose your discount
  4. Mid-periodLight-touch annual data reporting in two-year periods

Submit CCA target period data for 2026

Who it affects: Facilities holding a Climate Change Agreement

Report energy use and output for target period 7 so performance against your facility target can be assessed. Any shortfall means a buy-out fee.

Heavy industry & manufacturing Checked 3 Nov 2026 · Source
in 179 days

Key facts

The prize
92% off the Climate Change Levy on electricity and 89% off gas (2026 rates)
Discount runs to
31 March 2033
Targets
Set for each facility, not grouped
Missed target
Pay a buy-out fee per tonne CO₂e. If you don't pay, the agreement is decertified and you lose the discount
Practical tip

Check your metering covers exactly the eligible process. Energy for non-eligible activities on the same site can push you over target.
